blocks.text: Modern mobile development moves fast, but the underlying challenge remains consistent: how to write software that stays performant, clear, and easy to maintain as product requirements evolve. When architecting mobile applications at scale, separating concerns between state, business logic, and UI rendering is the most reliable way to avoid brittle regressions. Here is how clean design patterns clarify real-world implementation.

items: Explicit state modeling with immutable data structures.

blocks.text: Great code is not code that is clever; it is code that is predictable and painless to change six months later.
By focusing on predictable state and decoupled architecture, you insulate your codebase against platform shifts while delivering a noticeably faster experience to end users.
